title: Reinstatement Price of a Removed Design Studio Selections Option Line
content:
**Pricing rule.** The line reinstated is the most recently removed option line on the Design Studio Selections file. The reinstatement price is the reinstatement basis raised by the quote escalation percent and rounded half up to the cent, plus the re-order surcharge, the re-selection fee and the lender amendment fee, less the credit carried, never below zero. The reinstatement basis is the price at which the removed line had been selected, the quote escalation percent is zero, the re-order surcharge, the re-selection fee and the lender amendment fee are 0.00, and the credit carried is the design credit applied to the removed line less any credit returned to the file for that line, never below zero.

**Inputs**

- *Price at which the removed line had been selected* — the price on the line's selection entry.
- *Design credit applied to the removed line* — every credit application on the design ledger carrying that line number, whatever its source.
- *Credit returned to the file for that line* — every credit memo on the design ledger carrying that line number.

**Order of working.** The basis is raised by the escalation percent and rounded half up to the cent; the surcharge and the two fees are added; the credit carried is subtracted; a result below zero is 0.00, and the price is stated to the cent.

**Worked figures (hypothetical line selected at 3000.00, design credit applied to it 800.00)**

| Credit returned for that line | Credit carried | Reinstatement price |
|---|---|---|
| None | 800.00 | 3000.00 less 800.00: 2200.00 |
| 480.00 | 320.00 | 3000.00 less 320.00: 2680.00 |
| 800.00 | 0.00 | 3000.00 |
